description: This file defines an image classification class within the ImageAI library, including model setup, image preprocessing, and classification methods, utilizing PyTorch and torchvision models.

classes.name: ImageClassification
classes.description: A class for performing image classification using various deep learning models such as ResNet50, DenseNet121, InceptionV3, and MobileNetV2, with methods for setting model type, loading models, and classifying images.

methods.name: setModelPath
methods.description: Sets the file path to the pretrained model, verifying the file exists and checking its extension.

methods.name: __load_classes
methods.description: Loads class labels from the 'imagenet_classes.txt' file.

methods.name: __load_image
methods.description: Preprocesses input images (file path, numpy array, or PIL Image) into a tensor suitable for model input.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsResNet50
methods.description: Configures the classifier to use the ResNet50 model.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsDenseNet121
methods.description: Configures the classifier to use the DenseNet121 model.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsInceptionV3
methods.description: Configures the classifier to use the InceptionV3 model.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsMobileNetV2
methods.description: Configures the classifier to use the MobileNetV2 model.

methods.name: useCPU
methods.description: Forces the classification to run on CPU.

methods.name: loadModel
methods.description: Loads the model weights from the specified file path into the model architecture.

methods.name: classifyImage
methods.description: Classifies an input image (file path, numpy array, or PIL Image) and returns the top predictions with probabilities.
